title: Sähköisen ilmailun ratkaisut Tampere-Pirkkala lentokenttäalueelle
description: Sähköisen ilmailun ratkaisut Tampere-Pirkkala lentokenttäalueelle, TMP Zero (EAKR) hanke: Osa 1: Sähköisen ilmailun pohjakonseptin suunnittelupalvelu Osa 2: Digitaalisen kaksosen rakentamispalvelu Osa nro 1: Sähköisen ilmailun pohjakonseptin suunnittelupalvelu (TP2.4.) Laaditaan pohjakonsepti Tampere-Pirkkalan lentoaseman ja sen ilmaliikenteen sähköistymiseksi. Vaiheessa kartoitetaan millaisia muutoksia infrastruktuurin näkökulmasta sähköinen lentoliikenne tuo mukanaan (esim. tilantarve, latausjärjestelyt, sähköverkon kapasiteetti). Tarkastelussa huomioidaan sekä matkustajalentoliikenne että muu lentoliikenne, mm. koulutustoiminta. Muutostarpeita määrittäessä huomioidaan ilmailun kasvunäkymät. Kun muutostarpeet on määritetty, tarkastellaan TP2.4:ssa sähköverkon kapasiteetin riittävyyttä näiden näkökulmasta. Kapasiteettihaasteiden ilmentyessä, tehdään vaiheessa suunnitelma kapasiteetin riittävyyden varmistamiseksi. Lisäksi vaiheessa tarkastellaan lentoaseman ympäristön ja sitä ympäröivien teollisuusalueiden mahdollisuudet puhtaaseen energiantuotantoon ja tämän hyödyntämiseen lentoasemaympäristön sähkön tarpeessa. Energiantuotannon osalta tarkastellaan uusiutuvat energianlähteet sähköntuotannossa (aurinko, tuuli ja biopolttoaineet, erityisesti biokaasu). Lisäksi tarkastellaan vedyn mahdollisuudet osaratkaisuna ja arvioidaan vetytehtaan perustamisedellytyksiä kohdealueella. Vaiheessa huomioidaan lentoasemaan liittyvät turvallisuus- ja ympäristövaikutusten näkökulmat sekä lainsäädännön tuomat velvoitteet. Työmenetelmänä käytetään ostopalveluna hankittavaa asiantuntemusta aihepiiristä, yhdessä lentoasemaympäristön toimijoiden kanssa tehtävää työpajatyöskentelyä sekä Digital Twinin avulla tehtävää mallinnusta ja eri vaihtoehtojen vertailua. Karttapalvelulla luodaan kokonais- ja tilannekuva hankealueesta ja sen ympäristöstä vaikutusalueineen. 2D-karttapalvelu tukee avoimia rajapintoja sekä paikkatiedon ja suunnitteluaineistojen julkaisua selainpohjaisesti ilman erillisiä ohjelmistolisenssejä. Tämä mahdollistaa tiedon jakamisen helposti kaikkien kiinnostuneiden saataville. Karttapalvelu on yhdistettävissä tiedonhallintajärjestelmään ja se toimii samalla dokumenttien hallintajärjestelmänä sekä eri käyttäjä- ja sidosryhmien informaation jakeluportaalina. Karttapalveluun saadaan helposti tuotua esimerkiksi Finavian kenttäympäristön lähtötiedot sekä tulevaisuuden suunnitelmat, Pirkkalan kunnan sekä lähialueen valittujen toimijoiden, kuten sähköverkon omistajan, käyttöön antamat lähtötiedot. Nämä lähtötiedot kerätään pohjakonseptin suunnitteluvaiheessa. Osatarjouksen nro 1. sisältövaatimukset Pohjakonseptin suunnittelu, jossa mallinnettu - nykyinen infra TMP -lentokenttäalueella - logistiikka mitoitus - toimijoiden tarvekartoitus - datamalli digital twin toteutukseen Työohjelma - vaiheistettu työohjelma - keskeiset suunnittelupisteet - keskeiset arviointikohdat Toteuttavan tiimin esittely - logistiikkasuunnittelukokemus - liikennejärjestelmätuntemus - ilmailualan tuntemus, erityisesti sähköinen lentäminen ja drone -logistiikka Asiakasreferenssit (ladattava liitetiedosto). Osa nro 2: Digitaalisen kaksosen rakentamispalvelu Rakennetaan hankkeen hallintaan ja visualisointiin monipuoliset digitaaliset työkalut. Tarkoitus on ensin laatia selainpohjainen 2D -karttapalvelu (paikkatietomuotoinen eli GIS) hankkeen kokonaistilannekuvan ja dokumenttien hallintaan sekä siitä jatkokehiteltävä dynaaminen 3D-ympäristössä toimiva Digital Twin, joka tukee mm. tietomallimuotoista (BIM) suunnitteluaineistoa. Karttapalvelulla luodaan kokonais- ja tilannekuva hankealueesta ja sen ympäristöstä vaikutusalueineen. 2D-karttapalvelu tukee avoimia rajapintoja sekä paikkatiedon ja suunnitteluaineistojen julkaisua selainpohjaisesti ilman erillisiä ohjelmistolisenssejä. Tämä mahdollistaa tiedon jakamisen helposti kaikkien kiinnostuneiden saataville. Karttapalvelu on yhdistettävissä tiedonhallintajärjestelmään ja se toimii samalla dokumenttien hallintajärjestelmänä sekä eri käyttäjä- ja sidosryhmien informaation jakeluportaalina. Karttapalveluun saadaan helposti tuotua esimerkiksi Finavian kenttäympäristön lähtötiedot sekä tulevaisuuden suunnitelmat, Pirkkalan kunnan sekä lähialueen valittujen toimijoiden, kuten sähköverkon omistajan, käyttöön antamat lähtötiedot. Digital Twin on peliteknologiaan perustuva dynaaminen ja visuaalinen 3D -käyttöympäristö ja alusta, johon tuodaan muista suunnittelu- ja mallinnusohjelmistoissa tuotettujen mallien geometriset tietosisällöt. title: 81322849 - Capacity development and organisational support for convergent implementation of measures to improve water security in rural India
description: The overall scope of the envisioned service contract is to conduct capacity development and on-the-job training to develop local water security plans and provide organizational support for the convergent implementation and monitoring of water security measures in the 12 partner districts. In particular, the contractor shall be responsible for providing the following work packages: Work package 1: Conduct capacity development and on-the-job training to develop local water security plans in the 12 partner districts. This work package connects the results of Output 1, in particular, the development of a Rural Water Security (RWS) framework for Integrated Water Security Assessment and Planning, to Output 2, in particular, the elaboration of local water security plans and their convergent implementation and impact monitoring in the 12 selected partner districts. This includes the implementation of on-the-job training for employees of local authorities in order to enable them to develop data-driven and GIS-based water security action plans at local level. Regular training workshops are to be conducted at state, district and block level which have to be coordinated with the local authorities by the consultant"s respective state and district coordinator. Main activities under this work package may include: - Onboarding and familiarization with existing frameworks, digital tools, and training material for conducting capacity development drives - Conducting capacity development drives in demonstration districts - Provide technical (handholding) support for preparation of local water security plans Work package 2: Organizational support for the convergent implementation and monitoring of water security measures in the 12 partner districts. In order to ensure convergent planning and implementation of water security measures using government programmes and missions in line with the Indian government's "Whole of Government Approach" as well as the involvement of the private sector and civil society, steering mechanisms at district level are to be strengthened through organisational advice to the local authorities in the partner districts. This can be achieved, for example, by setting up cross-sectoral convergence committees or working groups comprising relevant representatives of interest groups or decision-makers in the partner districts. The convergent implementation of measures to improve water security by the competent authorities at district, block and municipal level is ensured by mobilising financial resources for implementation (materials, equipment, wages), taking into account the implementation modalities of the respective state programmes and missions as well as the private sector. The effectiveness of convergent planning and implementation is increased through the use of existing and new incentive mechanisms by local authorities at the district level, such as recognition of successfully implemented innovative measures to improve water security, public awards, the provision of additional funds, the mobilisation of private sector investment, etc. Main activities under this work package may include: - Analyse, support, and strengthen district-level steering mechanisms for convergent implementation - Explore and strengthen incentive mechanisms for convergent implementation of measures to improve water security - Explore and strengthen potential cooperation with other stakeholders (JJM, MCAD, private sector, e.g. foundations, philanthropies, CSR) in demonstration districts of improve RWS - Provide thematic expert advice, technical backstopping and support in demonstration districts for convergent implementation and impact monitoring Work package 3: Evaluation and documentation of scalable and replicable successful applications of the RWS planning framework and convergent implementation of water security measures. The Consultant will contribute to the evaluation and documentation of successfully demonstrated practices that can be disseminated by the Departments of Rural Development (DoRD) and Water Resources (DoWR) at the state and partner ministries (MoRD and MoJS) and NITI Aayog at the national level. This also includes target group-oriented materials for institutions of village self-government, civil society organisations, community-based organisations as well as private sector and philanthropic actors. By demonstrating the concept and applicability of practice-oriented approaches and digital solutions, the successfully demonstrated practices can be integrated into the programme delivery systems at the national, state and district levels via the partner ministries and their subordinate authorities. Activities under this work package may include: - Identify, evaluate, and document scalable and replicable successful applications of the RWS planning framework and convergent implementation of water security measures - Contribute to the elaboration of target group-oriented materials and knowledge products - Conduct state-level workshops and seminars on successfully demonstrated practices and innovative measures - Contribute to the integration of successfully demonstrated practices into the programme delivery systems

title: MODEL-BASED SYSTEM ENGINEERING FOR INTERFACE MANAGEMENT - EXPRO PLUS
description: The objective of this activity is to develop an interface engineering toolset providing electronic data sheet support for avionics and software development of space applications.Description: In deploying Model-Based System Engineering (MBSE) in space projects, one of high priority elements is the management of interface. This activity builds upon a concept of exchange of interface called Electronic Data Sheet (EDS) which applies to software interface and equipment functional interface and is extended towards electrical interface. This activity aims at providing a toolset to support interface engineering activities, with the following capabilities: Provide means to capture the Electrical and Data interface of an equipment, with different levels of abstraction, from functional to physical. Process this input data to generate ECSS-compliant Interface Control Documents (ICD). Generate EDS material in a flexible way: the design shall provide customizable backend templates allowing to adapt to existing, legacy EDS formats already in place at system integrators. Compatibility with an MBSE process and supporting the transition between system and software developments. Compliance to ECSS-E-ST-10-24C standard (Interface Management). Provide support of both ECSS-E-ST-70-41C Packet Utilization Standard (PUS)terminals and legacy/raw TM/TC interface.The main objective of this activity is to consolidate the notion of interface, from its definition in the Space System Ontology (a semantic description of data models aiming at interoperability of data), to the specification of a complemented version of the EDS format, applicable across disciplines.The following tasks are foreseen in this activity: Consolidation of the "TMTC interface" concept in the Interface Management standard from ECSS, as well as in the Space System Ontology, consistent with the existing system engineering ontology. Analysis of the perimeter of consolidation of the existing EDS, definition of EDS use cases at large. Establishment of the desired DRD (Document Requirements Definition) by crosschecking/merging the ones existing is various ECSS standards (E40C, E10-24C). Analysis of existing technologies to be extended (opus2, ASN1SCC) to support the capture of interface at system and equipment levels. Specification, design and implementation of the interface engineering toolset. Provision of use cases for validation, using equipment/units that are based either on PUS terminals or raw TM/TC interface, and using various network connections (preferably reusing of a reference functional architecture). Demonstration of use cases of exchange of interface between a customer and a (product) supplier using the EDS and ICD outputs of the tool. Demonstration of the EDS in its capability to ensure consistency between the functional (TMTC) and the electrical domains. Analysis of the business impact of this EDS for space applications. Integration of the EDS in the existing MBSE models of the avionics and the Power Reference Architecture.

Високите стандарти и изисквания на EARLINET по отношение на използваната лидарна техника и методики, техните периодични тестове, сертификации, както и верификацията на получаваните данни, са атестат и предпоставка, гарантиращи високото качество на провеждане на изследванията, както и надеждността на техните резултати. София, България, към национални, европейски и световни центрове за данни. Софийската станция на EARLINET- ACTRIS (Sofia IE-BAS) в ИЕ-БАН – единствена в България, с цялостната си дейност, представя страната ни и е ценен партньор в Европейските изследователски (инфра)структури по атмосферни изследвания. През 2021 г. в резултат на проведена обществена поръчка с предмет: „Доставка на многоканален аерозолен лидар“ (уникален номер на поръчката в АОП 01496-2020-0001) в ИЕ-БАН беше закупен и инсталиран многоканален аерозолен лидар модел Raymetrics LR332-D300, който напълно отговаря на оптималните технически изисквания към Националните комплекси за дистанционно изследване на аерозоли на Европейската научноизследователска инфраструктура ACTRIS и на инструментите и протоколите за осигуряване на качество на данните на Европейската аерозолна лидарна мрежа EARLINET. Лидарната система представлява уникална научно-изследователска апаратура – единствена в България. С нея се извършват систематични координирани дистанционни изследвания на атмосферни аерозоли (фини прахови частици) в рамките на EARLINET и ACTRIS. Резултатите от провежданите изследвания се депозират в централизирана база-данни на EARLINET- ACTRIS и имат важно значение за проследяване на климатичните изменения и въздействията на атмосферните аерозоли върху екологията и човешкото здраве. Поради възникнала необходимост от замяна на лазерния източник за наличния в ИЕ-БАН многоканален аерозолен лидар модел Raymetrics LR332-D300 с цел продължаване на оперативната дейност на Лабораторията, е необходимо закупуването на нов лазер. Лазерът в качеството му на лидарен трансмитер – източник на сондиращо атмосферата лазерно лъчение, трябва да има изходни енергетични, спектрални и времеви параметри и режими на работа, удовлетворяващи високите и специализирани изисквания и стандарти на ACTRIS/EARLINET. В съответствие с тези стандарти, в състава на лидарната система, работата на лазера трябва да бъде в прецизен функционален и времеви синхрон и съгласуваност с работата на останалите модули и компоненти на системата, при провеждане на вариращи по тип и режими автоматизирани лидарни измервания на атмосферни аерозоли и/или на високо-специализирани и с програмиран тайминг тестови измервания за качествен контрол (Quality Assurance-Quality Check). За тези цели, електронното и програмното управление на работните режими на лазера в наличния в ИЕ-БАН многоканален аерозолен лидар модел Raymetrics LR332-D300 се осъществява с разработени от фирма Raymetrics оригинални хардуерни програмируеми компоненти, инкорпорирани в конструкцията му и управлявани от специализирания софтуер на Raymetrics за цялостното управление на лидара. Това прави лазерният източник в лидарната система LR332-D300 на Raymetrics уникален инструмент, който при необходимост от замяна, може да бъде доставен, инсталиран и успешно въведен в експлоатация единствено от производителя на самия лидар – компанията Raymetrics S.A. title: RADIATION EFFECTS INSIDE THE SPACECRAFT COMPATIBLE WITH ADHA DEVELOPMENT- EXPRO+
description: Objective: To develop a breadboard of a radiation detection unit based on Advanced Data Handling Architectures (ADHA) in order to minimise on-board resources, while improving the integration and deployment.Description: The Agency has had success developing and flying radiation monitors, starting with the REM in the 90's, the SREM in the 2000s, and the EMU and NGRMs since 2017. These monitors have all been self contained and externally mounted, with masses and power requirements exceeding 1 kg and 2 W - low resource, butnot insignificant. Some of these instruments have housed dosimeters, but none have provided measurements within the other spacecraft units. At the moment, there are no low resource radiation monitors available capable of integration within the spacecraft and its units where the sensitive systems are located and capable to provide useful, unparalleled feedback to satellite operations. The benefits include enabled monitoring of the spacecraft health, and providing useful operational diagnostics, and accurate information on the environment. Radiation monitors are the first modules to be discarded during phase A of design due to additional mass and power budget constraints. This disrupts the huge potential of in-orbit data collection, which affects radiation model accuracy and uncertainty a measure, Radiation monitor will allow to manage approach to radiation effects, potentially extending mission lifetimes and opening the door to widespread use of COTS. It is envisaged that this should become standard on all platforms as part of S/C 'health' data - as is already done with thermal measurements. In order to enhance the European competitiveness for LEO applications for mid-size satellites, it is aimed to design and test a portfolio of standardized dosimeters and memories. By including the radiation monitors in the Advanced Data Handling architecture (ADHA), standardized, interchangeable, and inter-operable electronics modules equipped with the latest generation of microelectronics components can be integrated within the spacecraft units. Components and commercialprocesses from European foundries and manufacturers shall be baselined for dose measurements. Several configuration can be considered: detection unit embedded into each ADHA board, detection unit placed at different point of ADHA or to be considered as a standalone board. This activity encompasses the following tasks: - A trade-off shall be made between of the different solutions considered -Breadboarding and functional testing - Total ionising Dose and SEE testing - Roadmap to fully characterise and fly European memories once they become availableDeliverables: Breadboard, Report
